methodology.static: Exact-byte vocabulary counts and bounded inspection of the embedded JavaScript (one bundled chunk is readable source; the runtime selector code is Bun bytecode and was decoded from its string table plus --debug-file log lines). Literal presence is distinct from reachable behavior. Medium confidence for minified call-graph readings.
methodology.live: Unmodified installed binary, --bare -p, --tools '' (empty built-in tool set), --setting-sources '', --strict-mcp-config, explicit loopback-only MCP fixture, --debug-file. Each case used a fresh temporary cwd and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR under env -i. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was a dummy value and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL pointed to a local deterministic Messages stub holding its first response for 8 s so list-change delivery was observable. No real model inference or shared-service mutation. Fixtures: fixtures/claude-mcp-fixture.py, fixtures/claude-messages-stub.py, fixtures/claude-audit-matrix.sh.
methodology.fixture: Discover advertised 2026-07-28 and 2025-11-25, all three catalog listChanged capabilities, resources.subscribe and the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension. Listen answered as chunked SSE with the acknowledgement first, its subscription id equal to the listen request id, then tools/resources/prompts list_changed after the initial catalog lists. The legacy fixture rejected discover with -32601 and answered initialize at the requested version with Mcp-Session-Id and legacy tasks advertised, holding the GET stream. The drop fixture closed the first listen stream right after the notifications with no terminal JSON-RPC result.
fixture_lessons: The acknowledgement is matched by _meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId'] EQUAL TO the listen request's JSON-RPC id; a server-minted id is ignored, the client waits ~25 s at connect time, sends notifications/cancelled for the listen id, and proceeds without a stream.
Selectors must reach the process as separate env assignments; a zsh loop passed both in one token and Claude logged the pair as invalid and stayed on the v1 arm.
The Messages stub must terminate its SSE body (chunked or Connection: close), or the client waits on the stream forever.
limits: Account-specific remote rollout flags were not inspected; isolated defaults are not a universal rollout verdict.
Prompt/resource catalogs were empty; only tool refetches were observed after list_changed notifications.
No task result was returned to a client that did not declare support. Task execution and task notifications were not tested.
No per-URI resource subscription, MRTR elicitation interaction, or prolonged reconnect/parking behavior was live-tested.
The claude.ai connector projection headers were decoded statically only; no claude.ai connector was contacted.

task_gate.effect: Client capabilities are {roots:{listChanged:true},elicitation:{}} plus tasks only when this gate is true; the v2 extension insertion of io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks is also conditional on it. Renamed from LI in 2.1.267; still literally false.
